f3_program: collection("global_gym.gyms", "gym", "global_gym", source("They have 20 gyms"))
observe(at("global_gym.gyms.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("They have 20 gyms"))
collection("global_gym.cardio_machines", "cardio_machine", "global_gym.gyms", source("all of its cardio machines"))
observe(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.bike.count_per_gym", "current"), 10, "count", source("Each gym has 10 bikes, 5 treadmills, and 5 elliptical machines"))
observe(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.treadmill.count_per_gym", "current"), 5, "count", source("Each gym has 10 bikes, 5 treadmills, and 5 elliptical machines"))
observe(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.elliptical_machine.count_per_gym", "current"), 5, "count", source("Each gym has 10 bikes, 5 treadmills, and 5 elliptical machines"))
observe(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.bike.unit_cost", "current"), 700, "dollar", source("The bikes cost $700 each"))
percent_more(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.treadmill.unit_cost", "current"), at("global_gym.cardio_machines.bike.unit_cost", "current"), 50, source("The treadmills cost 50% more than that"))

multiple(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.elliptical_machine.unit_cost", "current"), at("global_gym.cardio_machines.treadmill.unit_cost", "current"), 2, source("The elliptical machines are twice as expensive as the treadmills"))
query("value", at("global_gym.cardio_machines.total_replacement_cost", "current"))
collection("james.houses_visited", "house", "james", source("James visits 20 houses"))
observe(at("james.houses_visited.count", "day_1"), 20, "count", source("James visits 20 houses"))
same(at("james.houses_with_sales.count", "day_1"), at("james.houses_visited.count", "day_1"), source("He manages to sell something in every house"))
multiple(at("james.houses_visited.count", "day_2"), at("james.houses_visited.count", "day_1"), 2, source("The next day he visits twice as many houses"))
percent_of(at("james.houses_with_sales.count", "day_2"), at("james.houses_visited.count", "day_2"), 80, source("only sold to 80% of houses"))
collection("james.items_sold", "item", "james.houses_with_sales", source("sold two things at each house in each of the two days"))
rate_relation(at("james.items_sold.count", "day_1"), 2, at("james.houses_with_sales.count", "day_1"), source("sold two things at each house in each of the two days"))
rate_relation(at("james.items_sold.count", "day_2"), 2, at("james.houses_with_sales.count", "day_2"), source("sold two things at each house in each of the two days"))
query("sum", "james.items_sold", "two_days")

observe(at("group.closing_cash", "2018"), 121.6, "million_dollars", cell("Closing cash", "2018"))

query("value", at("group.closing_cash.percentage_change", "2018_to_2019"))
